cases.sql: SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS wp_posts.ID FROM wp_posts WHERE 1=1 AND ( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (9) AND object_id = wp_posts.ID ) = 1 AND wp_posts.ID NOT IN ( SELECT object_id FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (8) ) ) AND wp_posts.post_password = '' AND wp_posts.post_type = 'recipe' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish')) GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY wp_posts.post_date DESC, wp_posts.ID DESC LIMIT 0, 11

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS wp_posts.ID FROM wp_posts LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, MAX(CAST(meta_value AS DECIMAL(20,4))) AS value FROM wp_postmeta WHERE meta_key = '_recipe_time' GROUP BY post_id) AS cooklook_sort ON wp_posts.ID = cooklook_sort.post_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (8,9) AND object_id = wp_posts.ID ) = 2 ) AND wp_posts.post_password = '' AND wp_posts.post_type = 'recipe' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish')) GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY COALESCE(cooklook_sort.value, 0) ASC, wp_posts.post_date DESC, wp_posts.ID DESC LIMIT 0, 11

SELECT SQL_CALC_FOUND_ROWS wp_posts.ID FROM wp_posts LEFT JOIN (SELECT post_id, MAX(CAST(meta_value AS DECIMAL(20,4))) AS value FROM wp_postmeta WHERE meta_key = '_recipe_views' GROUP BY post_id) AS cooklook_sort ON wp_posts.ID = cooklook_sort.post_id WHERE 1=1 AND ( ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM wp_term_relationships WHERE term_taxonomy_id IN (9) AND object_id = wp_posts.ID ) = 1 ) AND wp_posts.post_password = '' AND wp_posts.post_type = 'recipe' AND ((wp_posts.post_status = 'publish')) AND wp_posts.ID IN (SELECT post_id FROM wp_postmeta WHERE meta_key = '_recipe_region' AND meta_value = 'Русская кухня') GROUP BY wp_posts.ID ORDER BY COALESCE(cooklook_sort.value, 0) DESC, wp_posts.post_date DESC, wp_posts.ID DESC LIMIT 0, 11
